components.name: Drone Bay Mk I
components.blurb: A hangar with a hatch and a rail. The rail is mostly straight.
components.quirk: Launches tier 1 drones. Re-arms in 12 s after a loss; a crew member in the bay room makes it 25% faster.

components.name: Drone Bay Mk II
components.blurb: Room for a better drone and a faster cradle. The racks are labelled, which is new.
components.quirk: Launches tier 1 and 2 drones. Re-arms in 9 s; a crew member in the bay room makes it 25% faster.

components.name: Drone Bay Mk III
components.blurb: A launch rail that hums. Everything in the cradle is flown, nothing is dropped.
components.quirk: Launches every tier. Re-arms in 6 s; a crew member in the bay room makes it 25% faster.
